The '''Leprechaun Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained at the waterfall near the [[Abandoned House]] in [[Cindersap Forest]]. Every year, on [[Spring]] 17, a [[Cindersap Forest#Pot of Gold|pot of gold]] appears at the end of a rainbow in that location. When the player interacts with the pot of gold, they receive the hat and some [[Gold]].<ref name="leprechaunhat" />

<gallery mode="nolines" widths="48px">
File:Pot Of Gold.png|Pot of Gold
</gallery>

==Notes==
The date of Spring 17 refers to [[Wikipedia:Saint Patrick's Day|St. Patrick's Day]], a holiday celebrated on March 17.
